name: JTBD1 — Stale content, raised 180-day bar
description: Threshold-variation of the stale-content JTBD. Requires ADMIN_TOOLS_ENABLED=true and site-admin PAT. Model raises the staleness bar to 180 days via query-admin-insights (kind=stale-content, minAgeDays 180) — a subset of the 90-day result. Read-only.
prompt: Raise the bar — which content is stale past 180 days? Use the Admin Insights stale-content view. Report the items and state the age threshold you filtered on. Do not modify or delete anything.
